boards.title: Your First Weekend at California State University-Bakersfield, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A Friday-to-Sunday introduction to CSUB through student gathering spaces, recreation, campus landmarks, and a documented welcome-weekend tradition.

cards.title: Start at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Find the campus hub
cards.notes: Begin in the lounge, locate the bookstore and food counters, then check posted information for student events before continuing outside.
cards.short_summary: Use CSUB’s central student-life building to get oriented and identify useful campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB states that the Student Union contains a lounge for meeting, studying, games, and conversation, plus Rowdy’s Place and the Roadrunner Bookstore.
cards.source_title: Student Union - The Hub of Student Life on Campus
cards.access_notes: Campus access and operating hours vary by term; confirm the hours posted on the official page before visiting.

cards.title: Step Out to Runner Park
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Learn an outdoor event space
cards.notes: Walk the grass area beside the Student Union and note its position as an easy landmark for returning to campus programs later.
cards.short_summary: Connect the Student Union to a named outdoor gathering space used for university events.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB identifies Runner Park as an outdoor grass area in front of and beside the Student Union with a stated event capacity of 200.
cards.access_notes: Ordinary outdoor access may be affected by reserved events; do not enter a setup or closed event area.

cards.title: Map Out the Stiern Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Preview the learning hub
cards.notes: Locate the service areas, group-study options, and research help you may need later; check the live library schedule before setting out.
cards.short_summary: Turn a first library visit into a practical preview of study and research resources.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB describes the five-floor Walter W. Stiern Library as housing collections, computer labs, classrooms, group study rooms, research help, and other services.
cards.access_notes: Weekend and intersession schedules can differ; verify current library hours on the library website before departure.

cards.title: Find Lab A Before You Need It
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Locate campus technology help
cards.notes: Go to the library’s lower level, identify the west-side entrance, and learn where printing, computer, and RunnerCard services are handled.
cards.short_summary: Locate a student-only technology and identification service before the academic week begins.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB says Lab A is on the Walter Stiern Library’s lower level and provides Mac and Windows computers, printing, technology services, and the Photo ID office.
cards.access_notes: Lab A is for CSUB students, staff, and faculty, is closed on weekends, and may close during summer; make this a Friday stop.

cards.title: Identify Runner Café
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • Learn a campus dining option
cards.notes: Locate the café while buildings are familiar, review the posted menu and service schedule, and decide whether it fits a later meal.
cards.short_summary: Add a named campus dining location to your mental map without assuming a particular order.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB’s catalog identifies Runner Café as one of the campus dining facilities operated by ARAMARK Higher Education.
cards.access_notes: Food requires purchase, and weekend availability is not established by the cited page; check current dining information first.

cards.title: Tour Your Recreation Options
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • Bring your RunnerCard
cards.notes: Check in with your CSUB ID, survey the gym and suspended track, and ask staff which recreation areas are available for informal use.
cards.short_summary: See which fitness, court, and wellness facilities are included for fee-paying students.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB documents a three-court gymnasium, suspended track, fitness equipment, study seating, nap pods, and massage chairs at the Student Recreation Center.
cards.access_notes: Fee-paying students have access through student fees and should bring a CSUB ID; confirm current facility hours before visiting.

cards.title: Try the Rock Wall
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday • Complete the required orientation
cards.notes: Ask wall staff for the first-use orientation, use the provided climbing equipment, and select a route appropriate to your experience.
cards.short_summary: Make a supervised first climbing session part of the weekend rather than improvising without staff.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB states that The Rock has tower and bouldering terrain and provides required climbing gear free of charge to members during operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Member access, signed policies, an initial orientation, and Rock staff presence are required; verify current wall hours.

cards.title: Pause at Alumni Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Add a second outdoor landmark
cards.notes: Walk through the named lawn, compare its location with Runner Park, and use the stop to practice navigating back toward central campus.
cards.short_summary: Learn a larger outdoor event lawn while reinforcing the campus layout on foot.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB lists Alumni Park as an outdoor venue used for receptions, barbecues, luncheons, festivals, and other events, with a capacity of 750.
cards.access_notes: Use only ordinarily open areas and yield to reserved programs, event equipment, or temporary closures.

cards.title: Locate the Doré Theatre
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Find a campus performance venue
cards.notes: Identify the theatre entrance and surrounding arts buildings now, then consult the university calendar before planning a ticketed performance.
cards.short_summary: Place CSUB’s principal named theatre on your campus map for future performances and programs.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB lists the Doré Theatre as a campus venue with auditorium seating, a stage, and a maximum capacity of 500.
cards.access_notes: The cited page establishes the venue, not public drop-in access; enter only for a scheduled, accessible program.

cards.title: Close with 'Runner Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Sunday • Join the documented welcome tradition when scheduled
cards.notes: Review the official weekend program, register when required, and choose age-inclusive activities that match your student or family status.
cards.short_summary: End the sequence with CSUB’s recurring transition weekend for new students and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUB describes 'Runner Family Weekend as a campus-wide transition celebration held before the fall term, with free events for new students and families.
cards.access_notes: Offered on the weekend before fall term; consult the current official program and complete any required registration.
